content:
Here you can ask Nuka Knights questions, which we will answer for you. You’ll always find the team’s answers at the top, though anyone is welcome to answer questions.

This gives us our own social network—exclusively for Fallout 76—independent of major platforms.

Be sure to check out the new private messaging feature, or feel free to upload your favorite outfits to the "Hot or Not" section. There, all members can "like" your looks. The most popular outfits are displayed here and updated every few days.

Also, take a look at the polls. We’ll use them to gauge the community's opinion on current topics, helping us discover what the majority really wants—provided as many of you as possible participate.

Have fun!
